name: Build B5: Native Manual (Native Manual Live View Exposure Simulation + Live Histogram)
description: Unlocks Nikon's dormant factory Manual Live View exposure routine (0x0012C22A) in Manual (M) mode via four 2-byte BEQ -> NOP patches while preserving B4's real-time 64-bin Live View luminance histogram, B1's EV compensation simulation (0x00222E5A), B2's EXIF/menu branding, and P/S/A Auto-AGC fallback.

edits_vs_b4.description: Gate 1 (0x0012C27E LV Entry / Large-Delta Mode A): NOP out BEQ 0x0012C2A4 on 0x9F87210F bit 4 so M mode calls 0x0012C22A
Gate 2 (0x0012C34A Per-Frame Tracking Mode A): NOP out BEQ 0x0012C370 on 0x9F87210F bit 4 so M mode calls 0x0012C22A every frame
Gate 3 (0x0012C402 LV Entry / Large-Delta Mode B): NOP out BEQ 0x0012C434 on 0x9F87210F bit 4 so M mode calls 0x0012C22A
Gate 4 (0x0012C56A Per-Frame Tracking Mode B): NOP out BEQ 0x0012C59C on 0x9F87210F bit 4 so M mode calls 0x0012C22A every frame
